action: Tom has a real conversation with his wife Sarah. Not a managed disclosure, not the version designed to reassure her. The actual conversation — what the 30 days looks like, what the savings number is, what the runway is, what the plan is to the extent there is a plan. He tells her about the retraining grant application. He tells her about Linda's offer to connect him to fleet and logistics contacts. He listens to what she is actually feeling, not what she is performing for him. This is the most important action of tick 9 and it is not on any professional to-do list.
